title: REQ · Admin round endpoints wired behind token auth with scheduler started
summary: POST rounds, open, close, GET round and contributions under /api/v1/admin
description: Context: lifecycle service and middleware exist but are not exposed. Desired behavior: POST /api/v1/admin/rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id}, GET /rounds/{id}/contributions behind admin.Middleware; contribution round lookup reads round.yaml so closed rounds reject submissions; scheduler started from main. Expected result: admin can drive a round over HTTP.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid token and world_id, when POST /admin/rounds, then 201 with the SCHEDULED round
Given an OPEN round, when POST close, then 200 with status CLOSED; illegal transition returns 409
Given no token, when any admin round route is called, then 401
Given an unknown round, when GET, then 404
technical_constraints: world_id passed as query parameter world for routes with {id}, body field for create
Use chi route group with admin.Middleware
